nodes.label: Castle redesign page contract (appendix)
nodes.rationale: Every row under Hooks must survive the rebuild exactly as described in Must keep, or the consumer named in Used by breaks; Corrections override earlier claims in the same group.

nodes.label: Page contract: base.html
nodes.rationale: Global shell (27 templates extend it): keep the CSRF, theme-init and shell inline scripts in order and every id/class, while building the new blue top bar.

nodes.label: Page contract: index.html
nodes.rationale: Landing page; the #installPWA FAB can be restyled freely if the id and inline display toggle survive.

nodes.label: Page contract: 404.html
nodes.rationale: Static page, free to rebuild; the 404 handler returns HTTP 200.

nodes.label: Page contract: 500.html
nodes.rationale: Keep dependency-free: anything added to base.html must not raise when rendered from an error handler (possibly with MongoDB down).

nodes.label: Page contract: offline.html
nodes.rationale: Standalone SW fallback page; re-skin with inline token variables and only cached assets.

nodes.label: Page contract: auth/login.html
nodes.rationale: Icon buttons inside the form must keep type=button or they submit the login form.

nodes.label: Page contract: auth/profile.html
nodes.rationale: No JS; markup is free to change, but guard created_at and keep the {%- -%} whitespace trimming.

nodes.label: Page contract: auth/settings.html
nodes.rationale: settings.js binds the first <form> in the document, so base.html must never add a form before the content block.

nodes.label: Page contract: scouting/add.html
nodes.rationale: The server contract is the field-name list and exact option values; keep the canvas container visible and fixed-size at load.

nodes.label: Page contract: scouting/edit.html
nodes.rationale: Identity fields must stay readonly, not disabled, because disabled inputs do not post and the update fails.

nodes.label: Page contract: scouting/_match_list.html
nodes.rationale: Keep table/tbody/tr.team-row/td order and do phone cards with CSS only, so row.cells, tbody append, innerText CSV and [hidden] keep working.

nodes.label: Page contract: scouting/pit-scouting-add.html
nodes.rationale: Field names and values are pinned by pit.py and tests/test_pit_form.py.

nodes.label: Page contract: team/create.html
nodes.rationale: Field classes must stay in the template (not forms.py render_kw) so the Tailwind scanner sees them.

nodes.label: Page contract: team/manage.html
nodes.rationale: Highest-risk page for a table-to-card conversion: manage.js reads tr/td positions in 5 places.

nodes.label: Page contract: team/settings.html
nodes.rationale: The route always writes request.form description, so a save bar outside the form (or a logo-only form) silently erases the team description.

nodes.label: Page contract: team/view.html
nodes.rationale: No JS hooks; keep url_for targets and anonymous rendering.

nodes.label: Page contract: scouting/leaderboard.html
nodes.rationale: Keep a real <table> with tbody[data-metric-sort]; team-stats.js sorting is shared with the match list.

nodes.label: Page contract: lighthouse.html
nodes.rationale: compare.js writes via getElementById without null checks, so dropping any id breaks the whole comparison.

nodes.label: Page contract: scouting/mock-alliance-selection.html
nodes.rationale: All alliance, slot, team-card and bracket markup is built in JS, so restyling means editing mock-alliance-selection.js and playoff-bracket.js.

nodes.label: Page contract: PWA shell (service-worker.js, manifest.json, notifications.js)
nodes.rationale: Its cache list must change whenever the rebuild adds, renames or deletes static files.

nodes.label: CSRF contract (meta tag, inline fetch wrapper, hidden csrf_token inputs)
nodes.rationale: Tests regex-scrape the meta and slice the IIFE by its exact text, so attribute order, the 'Send the CSRF token' comment and '(function () {' ... '})();' must stay verbatim in base.html.

nodes.label: Tailwind component layer (.card, .btn, .badge, .table, .link, .menu-item)
nodes.rationale: Restyle these classes in place (app/static/css/tailwind.input.css:24-142): they restyle the whole app at once, including JS-built markup.

nodes.label: 'hidden' class show/hide mechanism
nodes.rationale: Responsive display utilities (sm:flex, md:grid) beat .hidden, so never put them on toggled panels, tabs or modals.

nodes.label: [hidden] attribute vs display-class cascade bug
nodes.rationale: Preflight [hidden] is emitted before .btn and display utilities at equal specificity, so #loadMoreMatches never hides; add [hidden]{display:none !important} in @layer base.

nodes.label: Class-based dark mode on <html> (localStorage.theme)
nodes.rationale: compare.js observes html.dark to redraw the radar chart and auton.css / mock page use .dark rules, so dark must stay a class on documentElement.

nodes.label: Service worker STATIC_ASSETS precache and cache-name bump
nodes.rationale: Static assets are cache-first with no version query: bump cache names v14->v15 (CACHE_VERSION 15->16) after rebuilding CSS, or phones keep the old tailwind.css.

nodes.label: Canvas.js auto-path canvas contract (#autoPathContainer)
nodes.rationale: The container needs a definite non-zero size and must be displayed when new Canvas() runs; there is no ResizeObserver.

nodes.label: team-stats.js shared stats loader (.epa-value, tbody[data-metric-sort])
nodes.rationale: Shared by the leaderboard and the match list; changing its selectors affects both pages.

nodes.label: .mobile-menu-button / .mobile-menu shell hooks
nodes.rationale: querySelector with no null check: if either is missing, the inline script throws and the theme toggle and user dropdown never bind.

nodes.label: #nav-offline-indicator / #mobile-offline-indicator (body.offline)
nodes.rationale: base.js finds them by id; today the indicator is invisible on phones, so add a phone-visible one but keep the ids.

nodes.label: .animate-fade-in-up flash toast hook (and .container hazard)
nodes.rationale: Auto-dismiss removes child divs of any .animate-fade-in-up after 5 s; adding a .container class makes the silent form-canvas showStatus toasts appear.

nodes.label: Sticky full-width save bar (z-index stack, safe-area)
nodes.rationale: The bar must stay inside the <form> (or use form=) and must not be covered by the z-50 flash toast or update banner.

nodes.label: <main> px-4 gutter coupling (-mx-4 edge-bleed navs and save bars)
nodes.rationale: If the 16px phone gutter changes, the -mx-4 negative margins on save bars and scrolling tool navs must change with it.

nodes.label: CSS-only table-to-card on phones (td::before data-label)
nodes.rationale: JS reads tr/td positions, row.cells and innerText, so cards are done with a media query on the existing table elements, not div markup.

nodes.label: Tailwind content globs and red/blue safelist
nodes.rationale: Only ./app/templates/**/*.html and ./app/static/js/**/*.js are scanned; keep dynamic class names as complete literals.

nodes.label: Script-loading contract (classic scripts, order, currentScript)
nodes.rationale: base.js and settings.js read document.currentScript.dataset, so they stay classic scripts; the CSRF wrapper runs first and notifications.js loads before team/manage.js.

nodes.label: Global functions for inline onclick handlers
Match list partial/JSON pagination contract
nodes.rationale: GET /scouting?partial=1 returns {html,total,has_more,next_page}; list.js keeps only #teamDataContainer > .event-section > tbody > tr.team-row.

nodes.label: Scouting form field-name and value server contract
nodes.rationale: Field names and exact values (e.g. 'true' strings, robot_disabled None/Partially/Full, TBA match labels) are what the server parses.

nodes.label: Unpinned CDN dependencies (localforage, Sortable, Chart.js, Popper)
nodes.rationale: The SW never caches cross-origin requests, so a CDN failure at a venue kills the Canvas constructor; pin or self-host.

nodes.label: Richardson Brand Accelerator wordmark font
nodes.rationale: The file name has spaces, so the SW url.includes match fails on the percent-encoded request; rename to a woff2 without spaces.

nodes.label: Kit fit: taste-skill 2.5.1
nodes.rationale: Port the kit's tokens and rules into Tailwind on app pages and load kit files only on the landing page, because system.css/motion.css break Tailwind layouts and Castle components.

nodes.label: landing_base.html landing page plan
nodes.rationale: index.html picks its layout by auth state, so anonymous visitors get the kit landing shell while logged-in users keep the app shell.

nodes.label: Kit vs Castle class conflicts (.grid, .card, .btn, .link, .badge, main > section)
nodes.rationale: Fix conflicts by where files are loaded, never by editing kit files (kit-edited is an unwaivable gate FAIL).

Tables whose JS reads tr/td positions (CSS-only phone cards)
Forms that get the sticky full-width save bar
